description: 799 embedded definitions (789 .whfmt formats + 10 .grammar files) for automatic file format detection AND syntax highlighting. Covers 29 binary categories (Archives, Audio, Images, Game, ROMs, Executables, Disk, Crypto, Firmware, Fonts, GIS, IoT, MachineLearning, Network, RomHacking, Science, Subtitles, Synalysis, Text, Virtualization, ...) plus 57+ language grammars (C#, Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Swift, YAML, TOML, Markdown, Dockerfile, HCL, Nginx, WAT, and more). whfmt schema v3 (camelCase canonical): formatId, syntaxDefinition, signature/field/conditional/loop/repeating/pointer blocks, runtime expression engine (lexer + parser + AST cache + variable store + function registry), assertions, fuzz strategies, repair actions, migration descriptors. Cross-platform net8.0. Utility layer: FormatFileAnalyzer, FormatMatcher (scored confidence + negative-offset signatures), CatalogQuery (fluent), FormatMetadataExtensions (forensic/AI/assertions/diff/fuzz/repair), FormatSummaryBuilder, FormatAssertionEvaluator.
releaseNotes: 1.4.0 — Catalog: 856 embedded definitions (+57 formats since 1.3.2 across 3D, Game, Images, Network, Science and more). New companion NuGet: whfmt.Formats (content-only package — ships all 856 .whfmt files as AdditionalFiles; pair with whfmt.SourceGenerator to get compile-time C# parsers with no CLI step). README and title updated to reflect actual format count. Previous: 1.3.2 (whfmt v3 GA) — First public release of the whfmt v3 family. SCHEMA v3: 4 new root blocks (diff, repair, fuzz, migration); runtime expression engine (WhfmtExpressionEvaluator + variable store + 11 built-in functions + custom registration via IWhfmtFunction); FormatAssertionEvaluator bridges expressions to assertions[]; typed variables array; executable function descriptors; negative-offset signatures. CATALOG: 101 formats enriched with diff/repair/fuzz/migration across 15 categories; 8 new formats (PEM, DER, P12, GPG, UEFI, BIOS, UBoot, DNS); 6 priority formats fully wired (ZIP, PNG, PE/EXE, PDF, MP3, SQLite); cleanup Lots 1-7 (131 matchMode normalizations, 32 block-type swaps, 20 endian splits, 9 formatId collision renames, 8 fictive extensions, 12 exotic valueType mappings). COMPANION NUGETS now public: whfmt.Analysis, whfmt.Fuzz, whfmt.CodeGen, whfmt.Validate. PHASE B: bug fix FormatMatcher.ScoreEntry negative offsets; bug fix assertion engine bool/null variables; WhfmtExprNode AST internalized; schema category enum aligned to 31 values; direct unit tests added.
title: whfmt.FileFormatCatalog — 856 File Format & Language Definitions
